definitions.gloss: public will; popular opinion; the will of the people
definitions.explanation: The collective opinion or desire of the general public, especially in political contexts.

examples.japanese: {民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}させる→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧。
examples.english: To reflect the will of the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧だ。
examples.english: Elections are an important opportunity to show the will of the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}して→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}した→批判する：21993_hihansuru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition strongly criticized the government, saying it must not ignore the will of the people.

notes:
A formal term used primarily in political and journalistic contexts. Composed of {民|みん} (people) + ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧ (will, intention).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}する→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧ (reflect public opinion)
- {民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ (ask the public; put to public judgment)
- {民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧ (ignore the will of the people)
- {民意|みんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}う→沿う：13279_sou⟧ (align with public opinion)
- {民意|みんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{汲|く}み{取|と}る→汲み取る：25269_kumitoru⟧ (gauge public sentiment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧ — public opinion (broader, includes surveys and polls)
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ — the voice of the people (more informal expression)
- ⟦{民|たみ}→民：13246_tami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ — the heart of the people (literary/classical)
